subject: Withdrawn: legacy re-activation ask; route is Root's installed R97
body: Withdraws cloud-brain-publication-is-off-re-activate-on-th (#2248). Root's 6934058617 confirms R97 is installed with route native_sources_then_included_v4 and that a legacy publisher activation rewrite is not selected. Re-pinning activation on the current hashes is necessary but NOT sufficient for #2230/#2241: the public publisher scripts/mac/brain-proposal-pr.mjs (lines 1019-1029 at caeebaac) refuses every classifyDiff match before any branch or remote step, and both jobs' declared paths classify SAFETY_MACHINERY (scripts/**). Measured with the pinned classifier: lib/** and artifacts/api-server/** = DECISION_PATH, artifacts/signalgrid-web/** = OWNER_RESERVED, artifacts/mcp-server/** = SAFETY_MACHINERY; only unmatched paths (non-governance docs, some native views) pass. Do not weaken the guard or rewrite original receipts. Per #439 6934034939 and 6933870008: Root reads back the actual authorized versioned route for #2230 and installs the qualified fix through the existing Root route; #2230 continues from its frozen REVIEW artifacts; failed #2241 and uncertain originals stay immutable. Cloud remains the expected-head serial landing lane for the resulting PR.
